hooks.command: sh -c 'root="${DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; root="$(cd "$root" && pwd)" || exit 1; dir="$root"; while :; do if [ -f "$dir/agnostic-ai.yaml" ] || [ -f "$dir/agnostic.config.yaml" ]; then root="$dir"; break; fi; parent="$(dirname "$dir")"; if [ "$parent" = "$dir" ]; then root="$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; break; fi; dir="$parent"; done; bin=agnostic-ai; if [ -x "$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" ]; then bin="$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai"; else command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; fi; AGNOSTIC_AI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 "$bin" project --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "agnostic-ai: upgrade the selected package to a release supporting project; update its declared version and requires explicitly" >&2; exit 1; }; cd "$root" || exit 1; exec "$bin" project -- hook memory --target windsurf'
